# The felt of holes 1-3, generated by make_course.py from course.py (do not edit).
new
material new Felt --base-color 0.1686 0.8588 0.4471 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.6549 0.9608 0.2784 --no-slot
material new Tee --base-color 1.0000 0.6706 0.4824 --no-slot
# hole 1: THE MILL
add mesh grid --name Green1 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 81 --y-subdivisions 70 --location 0 0 0
scale 8.1000 7.0500 1
apply --scale
translate -11.1500 8.8250 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.6 * (clamp((pos.x - (-11.6)) / (-0.40000000000000036), 0, 1) * clamp((pos.x - (-11.6)) / (-0.40000000000000036), 0, 1) * (3 - 2 * clamp((pos.x - (-11.6)) / (-0.40000000000000036), 0, 1))) * (clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (-11.38)) / (2.860000000000001), 0, 1) * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (-11.38)) / (2.860000000000001), 0, 1) * (3 - 2 * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (-11.38)) / (2.860000000000001), 0, 1))) + 0.6 * clamp((pos.x - (-11.6)) / (-3.5999999999999996), 0, 1) * (clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (-8.52)) / (-2.860000000000001), 0, 1) * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (-8.52)) / (-2.860000000000001), 0, 1) * (3 - 2 * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (-8.52)) / (-2.860000000000001), 0, 1))) + 0.05 * 1 * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (-12.350000000000001)) / (5.150000000000001), 0, 1) + -0.03 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (-9.1)) * (pos.x - (-9.1)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (-10.0)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (-10.0))) / 0.2450))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > -15.200 && pos.x < -12.000 && (0 - pos.y) > -8.520 && (0 - pos.y) < -5.300) || (pos.x > -14.036 && pos.x < -13.165 && (0 - pos.y) > -11.380 && (0 - pos.y) < -8.520) || (pos.x > -15.200 && pos.x < -12.000 && (0 - pos.y) > -12.350 && (0 - pos.y) < -11.380) || (pos.x > -12.000 && pos.x < -7.100 && (0 - pos.y) > -12.350 && (0 - pos.y) < -7.200)) || ((pos.x - -9.1) * (pos.x - -9.1) + ((0 - pos.y) - -10.0) * ((0 - pos.y) - -10.0) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"
material assign Stripe
select face where "abs(pos.x - -13.6) < 0.4 && abs((0 - pos.y) - -5.9) < 0.4"
material assign Tee
mode object
shade flat
# hole 2: THE HUMP
add mesh grid --name Green2 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 98 --y-subdivisions 30 --location 0 0 0
scale 9.8000 3.0000 1
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 8.4000 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.32 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (0.3)) * (pos.x - (0.3)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (-8.65)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (-8.65))) / 1.2800) + 0.07 * (clamp((pos.x - (1.5)) / (3.4000000000000004), 0, 1) * clamp((pos.x - (1.5)) / (3.4000000000000004), 0, 1) * (3 - 2 * clamp((pos.x - (1.5)) / (3.4000000000000004), 0, 1))) * 1 + -0.03 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (3.3)) * (pos.x - (3.3)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (-8.05)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (-8.05))) / 0.2450))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > -4.900 && pos.x < 4.900 && (0 - pos.y) > -9.900 && (0 - pos.y) < -6.900)) || ((pos.x - 3.3) * (pos.x - 3.3) + ((0 - pos.y) - -8.05) * ((0 - pos.y) - -8.05) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"

shade flat
# hole 3: BROOK BRIDGE
